display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-33 Support to the SET Plan stakeholders’ groups in geothermal energy – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-33 Support to the SET Plan stakeholders’ groups in geothermal energy
executive_summary: A Horizon Europe Coordination and Support Action, funded as a lump sum, that supports the European Technology and Innovation Platform and the SET Plan (Strategic Energy Technology Plan) Implementation Working Group for geothermal energy, producing research and innovation roadmaps, analyses, data for SET Plan reporting and a plan to continue the fora without EU funding. One or more legal entities eligible under the standard Horizon Europe rules may apply. The budget is EUR 0.38 million for one project, with an indicative duration of 18 months. The call opens on 3 December 2026 and the single-stage deadline is 31 March 2027, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: The Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme 2026-2027 (Part 8), pp. 157–159, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds a single support action for the geothermal stakeholder fora of the SET Plan. The closest project file, Renewables Grid Initiative, is also a stakeholder network but concerns grid development, while this topic concerns only the geothermal sector's roadmaps and reporting, so it does not touch TenneT's field and is Not relevant.
